title: RealControlBench: A Benchmark for Interpretability-Informed Fine-Grained Control of LLMs and Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.27295v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing steering benchmarks are built around simplified, isolated generation tasks and evaluate a single behavioral attribute under controlled settings that do not reflect the diversity and complexity of practical deployment. As a result, performance on these benchmarks provides only a limited picture of how steering methods perform in the real world. We therefore introduce RealControlBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating fine-grained steering of LLMs and LLM agents across diverse behavioral targets and interaction settings. RealControlBench extends steering evaluation beyond isolated generations to complex, execution-grounded, multi-turn agent interactions, covering five complementary dimensions: instruction-following control, agentic tool-use decision control, reasoning-performance steering, reasoning-length control, and trajectory-conditioned safety awareness. translated_title: RealControlBench：一个面向基于可解释性的大语言模型与智能体细粒度控制的基准测试
translated_abstract: 现有的行为引导评测基准建立在简化的、孤立的生成任务之上，并在受控设置下仅评估单一行为属性，无法反映实际部署场景的多样性与复杂性。因此，在这些基准上的表现只能有限地反映引导方法在真实世界中的效果。为此，我们提出了RealControlBench，这是一个全面的基准测试，用于评估大语言模型与大语言模型智能体在多样行为目标和交互设置下的细粒度行为引导。RealControlBench将引导评测从孤立的生成任务扩展到复杂的、基于实际执行的多轮智能体交互，涵盖五个互补维度：指令遵循控制、智能体工具使用决策控制、推理性能引导、推理长度控制以及基于轨迹的安全意识。该基准并非仅测量引导的成功与否，而是……
tldr: 提出了RealControlBench，一个涵盖指令遵循、工具使用决策、推理性能与长度控制、安全意识五个维度的综合基准，用于在真实复杂的多轮智能体交互场景中评估大语言模型与智能体的细粒度行为控制。
en_tdlr: RealControlBench is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating fine-grained steering of LLMs and agents across five dimensions—including instruction following, tool-use decisions, reasoning control, and safety awareness—in realistic, multi-turn, execution-grounded agent interactions.
